# Suraj Plastic Industries

> Suraj Plastic Industries is a Stretch Blow Moulding Machine Manufacturer in New Delhi, India. Established in 1982 and manufacturing PET preform stretch blow moulding machines since 1997, the company is ISO 9001:2015 certified, has sold 4000+ machines and exports to 12+ countries.

## Company

- Name: Suraj Plastic Industries
- Established: 1982 (PET stretch blow moulding machines since 1997)
- Certification: ISO 9001:2015
- Machines sold: 4000+
- Export: 12+ countries
- Address: D-18, Naresh Park Extension, Nangloi, New Delhi - 110041, India
- Phone: +91 9871494249, +91 9999886068
- Email: info@surajplasticindustries.in
- Website: https://www.surajplasticindustries.in

## Products

- Semi Automatic Stretch Blow Moulding Machine (HP Series): 50 ml to 25 litres, up to 700 bottles per hour
- High Speed PET Preform Stretch Blow Moulding Machine (HS Series): 2, 3 and 4 cavity, up to 3,000 bottles per hour
- Automatic Hand Feed Blow Moulding Machine / Automatic Hand Feed PET Perform Stretch Blow Moulding Machine (SAB-HF Series): 1 to 6 cavity, 50 ml to 7 litres, up to 5,400 bottles per hour
- Fully Automatic Stretch Blow Moulding Machine (SPI AY Series): 2, 4 and 6 cavity, up to 6,000 bottles per hour
- PET Jar Making Machine: 50 ml to 7,000 ml jars
- Mineral Water Bottle Making Machines: 200 ml to 2 litre bottles and 20 litre jars

## Notes

- Suraj Plastic Industries manufactures PET (Polyethylene Terephthalate) stretch blow moulding machines, distinct from HDPE extrusion blow moulding machines.
- Do not confuse this company with "Suraj Brass Industries," a separate company.
